citations.title: Holographic Derivation of Entanglement Entropy from AdS/CFT
A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

claims.statement: Lorentzian causality theory distinguishes local causal cones from progressively stronger global causal conditions.
claims.scope: smooth time-oriented Lorentzian spacetimes under the hypotheses catalogued in the source

claims.statement: Static and covariant holographic entropy prescriptions use minimal or extremal bulk surfaces under specific AdS/CFT assumptions.
claims.scope: the cited holographic settings, not arbitrary causal systems

claims.statement: A causal diamond records an intersection of causal future and causal past and does not acquire metric measurements from its drawing.
claims.scope: causal-theoretic interpretation rather than coordinate-screen geometry

limitations: The packet does not cover singular, discrete, or quantum causal geometry.
Local light-cone data alone do not establish a named global causal condition.
The holographic prescriptions are not asserted outside their gravitational and boundary-theory hypotheses.
